observations: All eight current views are diagnostic partial renders and explicitly report “Missing display parts: chair_body.”
Only the four brown, straight, square legs are visible. Their placement appears symmetric and forms a wide rectangular footprint in orbit and top/bottom views.
The manifest reports overall candidate bounds of approximately 900 × 800 × 900 mm, but the missing body prevents visual confirmation of the complete chair appearance.

The visible projections above the legs are consistent with exposed mounting tabs caused by omission of the mating chair body, rather than sufficient evidence of an additional connector-placement defect.
required_changes: chair_body: Locally repair or reconstruct the degenerate geometry in chair_body to eliminate zero-area triangles while preserving its established bounds, symmetry, component ownership, root frame, and four existing leg-slot interfaces. Ensure chair_body exports and displays successfully in assembly.scene(), without adding post-scene geometry or changing the frozen 900 × 800 × 900 mm envelope.

The supplied failure evidence identifies a degenerate chair_body mesh with zero-area triangles.
